3/G.goal: Describe the application potential of XR and the technological categories of augmented reality, linking main AR application domains with marker-based and markerless AR system types.
3/G.achieves: Provides a foundational map of where and how AR is applied, enabling the learner to understand and evaluate later XR system development choices with confidence.

3/O1.goal: Describe the application potential of XR and the main augmented reality application domains, using consumer/customer-experience and healthcare examples that augment real-world content.
3/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a concrete understanding of where AR is used and what user problems it addresses, preparing them to connect later XR hardware, software, and development concepts to real application needs.

3/O2.goal: Classify augmented reality systems into marker-based and markerless categories and explain the location-based, superimposition-based, projection-based, and outlining-based markerless subtypes.
3/O2.achieves: Equips the learner to identify the technical basis of an AR system and to relate later tracking, sensor, computer-vision, and display topics to appropriate AR application types.
